about_the_game:
Mumbo Shuffle is a card-based roguelike deck builder where you explore a universe hidden at the edges of the TV signal. Along the way, you’ll be guided through this strange new reality by the Mumbos, digital creatures imbued with elemental power and their own unique decks. Pick your companion wisely as you navigate increasingly challenging goals. 

  • Play, Build, Shuffle - Score combos, build your deck, level up hands, and score big to progress through the universe.

  • Meet your Mates the Mumbos! - Just look at ‘em! These cheeky digital critters each bring their own unique decks. Every Mumbo has its own elemental strengths and weaknesses for maximum replayability.

  • Tune up your Strategy - Tune into ninety unique channels that alter your game experience, power up your multipliers, and win big.

  • Master the Elements - Here at the edge of the universe, the creative elements matter. Exploit elemental powers to blaze a pixelated path to glory. The powerful fire card will give you a toasty +15 power. It’s so good it’ll burn up the card!

  • Unique Teletex - Inspired Visuals - Classic visuals inspired by everyone’s favourite television-based information system. 

  • Test Signal - Tune into the test signal to discover the sandbox where you can experiment with builds and hone your skills.

  • Raise the Stakes with (potato) Chips! - Their nutritional value is negligible; their ingredient list is suspicious. Gamble with these delicious snacks to raise the difficulty!

  • Channel Surfing - Use the remote to navigate the digital universe, discover secret broadcasts, and find the mysterious hidden mini-games.

short_description: Load up on snacks, ready your remote, and join the mischievous Mumbos as you play, build, and jumble your way to victory in this card-based roguelike deckbuilder set in the hidden universe at the edges of the TV signal.
